E0 has KERNEL FATAL entries explicitly stating 'Error receiving packet on tree network, expecting type 57 instead of type 3' (e.g., E0-L7), whereas E5 (normal) shows no 'Error receiving packet on tree network' messages and instead reports 'rts: bad message header: expecting type <NUM> instead of type 3' across all its lines.
